intro: Project 1 of 3: predictive support and parts forecasting for an installed base of hardware, built the way a Services Operations team would use it.

runbook_hit_rate.note: share of truly deflectable cases (with a runbook in truth) whose top-scoring runbook is the generator's; 'family' scope can only hit when the generator stayed in the family

deflection.caveat: Cases and runbooks are generated (docs/GENERATOR.md). The generator sets `deflectable` from category, severity and coin flips, then copies a runbook phrase into deflectable descriptions; non-deflectable cases carry a stock phrase that is also a runbook's first symptom. Text matching therefore recovers the 'a runbook covers this symptom' precondition and cannot see the severity gate or the coins. These numbers measure the matcher against that ceiling, not whether any real case could have been deflected.
